GitHub repository: https://github.com/fanimarwa-bit/Charm-Prices

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

oil <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "oil.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
filo <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "filosofi.csv"),
                 col_types = cols(commune = "c"))
cog <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "cog.csv"),
                col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
```

```{r}
info <- tibble(
  file = c("oil.csv", "filosofi.csv", "cog.csv"),
  rows = c(nrow(oil), nrow(filo), nrow(cog)),
  columns = c(ncol(oil), ncol(filo), ncol(cog))
)

knitr::kable(info)
```

```{r}
ggplot(oil, aes(observation_date, brent_eur_l)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Brent crude oil (€ per litre)")
```
